correctness.rationale: For a+b>=3, classify B(selected)/W(unselected) along each short or long arm using the requirement that each white vertex have a black witness with exactly one white neighbor. With black hub, allowed two-arm BW/WB/BB and three-arm BBW/BWB/WBB/WWB/BBB; the only one-black long pattern WWB consumes the hub as unique white-neighbor witness and can occur once. Equality in size a+2b (b>=1) requires one WWB and all other long arms BBW/BWB plus all short arms BW, giving b*2^(b-1). With white hub, equality uses all short arms WB, all long arms BBW/BWB/WBB, at least one BBW to witness the center, giving 3^b-2^b. For b=0 black hub gives 2^a, white hub gives a, each of size a+1. Count invariant of a for b>=1 and exact boundary a+b>=3 follow. Independent all-subset witness-condition enumeration verified (a,b)=(3,0),(0,3),(2,1),(1,2),(2,2),(3,1), with respective (gamma,count) (4,11),(6,31),(4,2),(5,9),(6,9),(5,2). General tree gamma_sp(T)=order-matching is credited, not claimed novel.
